 Summary
 Arsenal taken to penalties by Fleetwood after 1-1 draw
 Dowman sent off for Gunners on 85 mins
 Match was delayed for eight minutes due to drone flying nearby 
 Cod Army are lowest ranked side left in competition
 Gillesphey and Phillips goals send Bradford into last eight with 2-0 win over Peterborough
 Quarter-final draw will take place after Wednesday's games
